title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate thunderstorms are expected today, with the primary threats being big hail, severe winds and heavy rain/possible floodings

---Discussion---

Storms in Poland should be scattered, but a one exception is made for the northern part of the SLGT area, where a quasi-linear system is forecast by multiple models.

About the storms in Czechia and Austria, there will be scattered to isolated cells, with few larger systems possible mainly in Austria, where training thunderstorms are also possible.

Near the Czech-Austrian border (hatched risk #2) we could see extensive rainfall, with measured values of 95+mm/3hrs possible, which would eventually cause damaging floodings in the area.

---Risk Areas---

SLGT
Austria, Czechia & Poland

Moderate thunderstorms are expected in most of the area through out the day.
The main threats are:
- Hail - up to 3.5
- Stronger wind gusts - mainly in Poland
- Heavy rain - mainly in Czechia-Austria
- Floodings - due to the heavy rain

---Hatched Areas---

Hatched #1
Poland

Similar threats as in SLGT, but increased probabilities.
The main threats are:
- hail - up to 3.5cm
- Severe wind gusts - 90+km/h possible
- Heavy rain

Hatched #2
Czechia & Austria

Issued for mainly extensive rainfall.
The main threat is:
- Heavy rain - Some models prompting up to 95mm/3hrs
- Damaging Floods
